# ilikefish.space

> ilikefish.space is a free, account-free browser game arcade. It hosts small HTML5 games that can be played instantly, many of which work offline after the site is loaded. The site is operated by fishesarethings; its own code and text are released under the Unlicense, while games and bundled assets remain with their respective authors.

Canonical site: https://ilikefish.space/
Contact: https://ilikefish.space/contact.html · https://github.com/fishesarethings/ilikefish.space/issues
Last updated: 2026-11-04

## What the site offers

- 18 small browser games across arcade, puzzle, idle/tycoon, strategy, educational and casual categories.
- No sign-up, download or purchase is required to play.
- The site is a progressive web app with offline support for cached pages.
- Game progress and preferences are stored locally in the browser. Games that offer optional online features send an anonymous Firebase ID, a chosen display name and game data to Google Firebase only when one of those features is used; see the privacy policy.
- A local-only recommendation system ranks games from the visitor’s play history; no play history is sent to a server.
- Advertising is provided by Google AdSense. Ads are labelled and kept outside the game area.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ilikefish.space/): featured and recommended games, all games, game-maker link.
- [All games](https://ilikefish.space/games/): the complete playable catalogue.
- [Game player](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html): the shared player wrapper; use ?folder=<folder> to open a game.
- [Game Maker](https://ilikefish.space/gamepack/): build and export a small game package.
- [About](https://ilikefish.space/about.html): who runs the site and how it works.
- [Notes](https://ilikefish.space/notes/): longer pieces on how the games are made, the advertising rules, offline play and a guide to the catalogue.
- [Contact](https://ilikefish.space/contact.html): questions, bugs, submissions and removal requests.
- [Privacy](https://ilikefish.space/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://ilikefish.space/terms.html).

## Games

- [Pong](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=pong): Pong is a free browser version of the arcade classic: rally the ball, angle your shots and beat the computer or a friend. Tags: arcade, sports, tennis, 2-player, local-multiplayer, retro, fast, skill, keyboard, gamepad.
- [Times Table Balloons](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=timestable-balloons): Times Table Balloons is a free maths game for practising multiplication: answer the questions and pop the correct balloon before it sinks. Tags: educational, math, arcade, timed, quick-play, high-score, touch.
- [Why on Earth Is the Chicken Crossing the Road](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=why-chicken-crossed): Why on Earth Is the Chicken Crossing the Road is a free road-crossing arcade game: dodge traffic, grab power-ups and get as far as you can. Tags: arcade, action, maze, runner, timing, challenge, fast, touch, high-score.
- [Tetnis](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=tetnis): Tetnis is a free block-stacking puzzle: rotate falling iron pieces, clear lines and keep the stack from reaching the top. Tags: puzzle, blocks, tetromino, arcade, retro, high-score, challenge, skill, touch.
- [Lawn Mower Simulator](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=lawnmower-simulator): Lawn Mower Simulator is a free relaxing game: drive the mower, cut every patch of grass and spend the coins on upgrades. Tags: simulator, chill, tycoon, open-ended, collect, upgrade, casual, keyboard, touch.
- [Block Bang](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=Block-bang): Block Bang is a free block-fitting puzzle: drag shapes onto an 8x8 grid, complete rows and columns to clear them, and keep the board from filling up. Tags: puzzle, blocks, match, arcade, fast, challenge, casual, touch.
- [Dice Roll Idle Empires](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=DiceRollIdleEmpires): Dice Roll Idle Empires is a free idle game: roll the dice, earn coins and reinvest in auto-rollers and upgrades that keep earning while you are away. Tags: idle, tycoon, dice, numbers, incremental, progression, chill, shop, upgrade, touch.
- [Gridbite](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=gridbite): Gridbite is a free local snake game for one or two players on a 16x16 grid, with keyboard, gamepad and touch controls. Tags: arcade, snake, grid, 2-player, local-multiplayer, fast, challenge, skill, keyboard, gamepad, touch, boost.
- [Rotaze](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=rotaze): Rotaze is a free rotating-maze puzzle game: steer through a maze that spins as you move, reach the flag and beat the timer. Tags: puzzle, maze, rotation, challenge, skill, timer, coins, shop, touch, casual.
- [Tower Defense](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=Tower-Defense): Tower Defense is a free browser strategy game: place towers along the path, upgrade them and stop every wave before it reaches the end. Tags: strategy, tower-defense, action, fantasy, waves, enemies, upgrade, challenge, touch, keyboard.
- [Dice Roll Idle Empires 2](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=DiceRollIdleEmpires2): Dice Roll Idle Empires 2 is a free idle game with a hard-mode economy, rebirth prestige and permanent ascension upgrades. Tags: idle, tycoon, dice, numbers, incremental, progression, chill, sequel, shop, upgrade.
- [Fish Climb Racing](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishclimbracing): Fish Climb Racing is a free side-scrolling swimmer: dodge obstacles, shoot, collect coins and unlock new fish as you push for distance. Tags: racing, action, fish, arcade, endless, coins, shop, fast, skill, touch.
- [Mine Tycoon](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=minetycoon): Mine Tycoon is a free idle mining game: build tunnels, hire workers, run carts to the lift and grow a mining operation. Tags: idle, tycoon, mining, clicker, incremental, progression, shop, upgrade, chill, touch.
- [Emoji Match](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=emojimatch): Emoji Match is a free emoji riddle game: read the phrase and pick the emojis that complete it. Quick rounds for phone or desktop. Tags: puzzle, memory, educational, match, timer, chill, touch.
- [Fishy Clicker I](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishyclicker): Fishy Clicker I is a free clicker game: tap the fish, watch the counter climb and see how many clicks you can rack up. Tags: clicker, idle, fish, incremental, chill, casual, touch.
- [Fishcore: Data Dive](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishcore): Fishcore: Data Dive is a free arcade swimmer: collect data, dodge corrupted programs, fight bosses and upgrade your fish between runs. Tags: action, fish, arcade, fast, skill, challenge, enemies, upgrade, touch.
- [Fish Tycoon](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=fishtycoon): Fish Tycoon is a free fishing tycoon game: build jetties, hire fishermen, send boats out and grow a fishing business. Tags: tycoon, idle, fish, management, progression, shop, upgrade, chill, casual, touch.
- [Fish Battle I](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html?folder=battlefishi): Fish Battle I is a free lane-battle game: spend Bubbles on fish, defend the reef and sink the boat before your health runs out. Tags: action, fish, arcade, enemies, levels, fast, challenge, touch.

## Technical notes

- Pages are static HTML/CSS/JavaScript hosted on GitHub Pages and delivered through Cloudflare.
- The player wraps each game in an iframe; games are plain HTML5/JS and do not require a plugin.
- `/llms-full.txt` contains a longer machine-readable catalogue with controls and feature notes.
- The site does not require login and does not expose private user data.
